answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the violet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The kernel is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the marble. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, capped per identity per epoch, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
